definitions.explanation: A Chinese dialect spoken primarily in Guangdong province, Hong Kong, and Macau. One of the major Chinese language varieties, distinct from Mandarin.

examples.japanese: {広東語|かんとんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
{香港|ほんこん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広東語|かんとんご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}されている→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: Cantonese is spoken in Hong Kong.

examples.japanese: {広東語|かんとんご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{北京語|ぺきんご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|つう}じない→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Cantonese and Mandarin have quite different pronunciations, so speakers sometimes cannot understand each other.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers specifically to the Chinese dialect spoken in the Guangdong ({広東|かんとん}) region, Hong Kong, and among many overseas Chinese communities. It is one of the most widely spoken Chinese dialects after Mandarin.

RELATED WORDS:
- {北京語|ぺきんご}: Mandarin Chinese (Beijing dialect)
- ⟦{中国語|ちゅうごくご}→中国語：10966_chuugokugo⟧: Chinese language (general term, usually refers to Mandarin)
- {上海語|しゃんはいご}: Shanghainese
